job: Move between settings pages from a side column.
purpose: The side navigation inside settings: a 280px column of 40px rows. When it cannot sit beside the content (a container under 760px) it turns into a row of pills that scrolls sideways. Links navigate; buttons get aria-current="true" on click. fd:change fires on selection.
useWhen: A settings or account area has four or more pages and a column beside them.
The list stays visible while the page content changes.

avoidWhen.when: The items are views of one object.
The links jump within one long page.
The items are categories in a catalogue.

states.name: current
states.how: aria-current="page" on a link, aria-current="true" on a button

states.name: overflowing
states.how: data-overflow on the pill row, set by nav.js

parts.role: One page; a link or a button.
A small count or badge at the end of the row.

keyboard.does: Follows a link or selects a button item.
